title: Renesas Launches RZ/G3L and RZ/G3SE: What Around 1 mW Standby Power Means and the Design Goals
excerpt: A look at the RZ/G3L and RZ/G3SE announced by Renesas on September 10, 2026. We cover the conditions behind the around-1 mW standby figure, how the Linux state is kept, the differences in video features, and why a common board design matters.
